what: of3t-orchestrator pass 396: how D242's repair lands -- four decisions, one of which inverts a standing rule of mine.
why_no_aiclk: CPU only; a design record that runs nothing

D1_THE_FIX_IS_THE_DEFAULT.decision: the graph-cut-correct injection becomes the DEFAULT; the old behaviour stays reachable as --legacy-total-cotangent; every artifact stamps which convention produced it
D1_THE_FIX_IS_THE_DEFAULT.why_this_inverts_my_own_rule: the standing rule makes a shared-instrument change opt-in so existing arms reproduce. That protects a CORRECT baseline from a SPECULATIVE change. Here the baseline is measured-wrong and the change is measured-right.
D1_THE_FIX_IS_THE_DEFAULT.the_distinction_worth_keeping: opt-in is the right default for a LEVER and the wrong default for a BUG FIX. A lever that defaults on is an unreviewed change; a bug fix that defaults off is a known defect left armed.
D1_THE_FIX_IS_THE_DEFAULT.what_the_stamp_buys: no reading is ever ambiguous about which functional it is on, which is the whole difficulty R160 had to untangle retrospectively.

D2_ONE_NAMESPACE_FOR_THE_RESCORES.decision: corrected readings are written into ONE new directory, never back into the concluded rows' namespaces
D2_ONE_NAMESPACE_FOR_THE_RESCORES.why: those rows have concluded and a row may not edit another's namespace (sibling-perf-campaigns-need-namespaced-output-paths)
D2_ONE_NAMESPACE_FOR_THE_RESCORES.and_the_second_benefit: one place to read the corrected campaign instead of a diff across fifteen namespaces

D3_LINEARITY_MEANS_NO_ARM_IS_RE_RUN_FROM.the_identity: g_corrected = g(cot_s, cot_z) - g(0, delta), with delta = autograd.grad(outputs=s_out, grad_outputs=cot_s, inputs=z_out)
D3_LINEARITY_MEANS_NO_ARM_IS_RE_RUN_FROM.why_it_holds: the parameter gradient is linear in the injected cotangent

and_it_is_measured_not_assumed.read: || g_sonly + g_zonly - g_ctrl || / || g_ctrl ||, in this exact setup

D3_LINEARITY_MEANS_NO_ARM_IS_RE_RUN_FROM.what_it_saves: g(cot_s, cot_z) is already banked for every arm, so each configuration needs ONE additional arm driven by (0, delta) rather than a re-run. That is the difference between a cheap re-score and card time on every device arm.
D3_LINEARITY_MEANS_NO_ARM_IS_RE_RUN_FROM.its_own_control_is_free: re-run ONE arm end to end with the corrected cotangent and it must reproduce the subtraction. If it does not, the linearity assumption is the thing that broke and the shortcut is withdrawn, not the repair.

D4_AUTHORISATION.why: trunkg043 has concluded; the change repairs the defect frameself root-caused; splitting fix from diagnosis would cost a full ramp-up to save nothing
D4_AUTHORISATION.limit: the edit is to that one file. Re-scores still go to one new namespace per decision 2, and no other concluded row's namespace is touched.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_DECIDE: whether the corrected readings clear the clause. That is pass 394's pre-registered ladder and one measurement, and no bar may be re-derived to meet it.
DOESNOT: this runs nothing and measures nothing. It settles four questions the repair would otherwise have improvised, one of which deliberately inverts a standing rule of mine and says why.
